{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 2.08

|eff= local

|descr= Set the PiP (Picture-in-Picture) view distance. This has no impact if PiP is disabled (see [[isPiPEnabled]]).

|gr1= System

|s1= [[setPiPViewDistance]] distance

|p1= distance: [[Number]] - distance in meters, minimum value is 100, maximum is [[viewDistance|current view distance]]

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>setPiPViewDistance 100;</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>setPiPViewDistance viewDistance;</sqf>

|x3= <sqf>setPiPViewDistance getObjectViewDistance;</sqf>

|seealso= [[getPiPViewDistance]] [[setViewDistance]] [[setObjectViewDistance]] [[viewDistance]] [[getObjectViewDistance]]
